questions.question: Which of these have parents of babies under six months already paid for or given up because of the night crying? Pick all that apply.

options.label: Money on baby apps or subscriptions (tracking, white noise)
Money on gadgets (sleep aids, swaddles, monitors)
Paid help so they can sleep (night nurse, doula)
Time off or a worse day at work after a bad night
Extra visits to a doctor or health visitor about the crying
None of these; they cope with what they have
